headline: Approved Option 4 as the preferred design for German Gerena Community School, estimated at $143,200,000, and its state submission.
summary: Designers presented Option 4 for the German Gerena Community School, a three-story, 124,248 SF school with an estimated total cost of $143,200,000. The group also approved a construction manager selection committee and a $3,206.50 contract amendment for a hydrant flow test.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the July 8, 2026 meeting, 5-0.
Approved Option 4 for the German Gerena Community School as the preferred solution, 5-0.
Approved and authorized DiNisco Design and Skanska Building USA to submit the German Gerena Community School Preferred Schematic Report to the Massachusetts School Building Authority, 5-0.
Approved appointing Peter J. Garvey, Emmanuel Russell and Steve Desilets as the Construction Manager at Risk selection committee, 5-0.
Approved Amendment #3 to the DiNisco Design designer contract, adding Hydrant Flow Test RE-06 for $3,206.50 for a new total contract price of $864,361.50, 5-0.

decision_evidence.quote: A motion to approve the Meeting Minutes of July 8, 2026 was made by Tom Ashe. Cathy Buono seconded the motion and it was unanimously approved.

Cathy Buono seconded motion approving Option 4 for the German Gerena Community School and it was unanimously approved. (Roll Call Vote: Tom Ashe, Cathy Buono, Steve Desilets, Marylou Ireland and Adam Lunghi) All members were in favor and none oppose and none abstained.

Cathy Buono seconded the motion approving and authorizing to submit the PSR for German Gerena Community School and it was unanimously approved. (Roll Call Vote: Tom Ashe, Cathy Buono, Steve Desilets, Marylou Ireland and Adam Lunghi) All members were in favor and none oppose and none abstained.

Cathy Buono approved the three appointed selection committee and it was unanimously approved. (Roll Call Vote: Tom Ashe, Cathy Buono, Steve Desilets, Marylou Ireland and Adam Lunghi) All members were in favor and none oppose and none abstained.

Cathy Buono seconded the motion approving the Amendment #3 to DiNisco Design., Designer Contract for the German Gerena Community School and it was unanimously approved. (Roll Call Vote: Tom Ashe, Cathy Buono, Steve Desilets, Marylou Ireland and Adam Lunghi) All members were in favor and none oppose and none abstained.
